rationale: All 7 prior blocking findings resolved: CR-001 hasActiveFilter derived via !checkEmptyFilters and forwarded through AssistantsList to AssistantGrid; CR-002 filterTerm.current cleared before popup-close reload; CR-003 projectOptions.length (raw count) announced; CR-004 null-totalCount guard added; CR-005 searchVersion dep wired through loadVersion; CR-006 prevHasActiveFilterRef suppresses false-positive on flag transition; CR-007 isTemplate branch selects correct zero-results noun.

business_review.item: AC1: Marketplace search announces result count after API response, no announcement before API responds
business_review.notes: hasActiveFilter never passed from AssistantsListPage; useEffect guard returns early unconditionally and no announcement ever fires

business_review.item: AC2: Marketplace zero results announces 'No assistants found'
business_review.notes: same root cause as AC1 — hasActiveFilter always undefined so the announce branch never executes

business_review.item: AC3: Paginating without active search does not trigger announcement
business_review.notes: hasActiveFilter=false/undefined guard correctly suppresses announcements on pagination

business_review.item: AC4: Project combobox filter announces count of matching options after async call resolves
business_review.notes: wiring correct; runtime verification required

business_review.notes: wiring correct; runtime verification required

business_review.item: AC8: Searching for the same term twice causes two announcements
business_review.notes: combobox surfaces replay correctly via new array references; AssistantGrid primitive deps [totalCount, hasActiveFilter] prevent effect re-fire when same count returned on second search

business_review.item: AC9: Visual appearance of all four surfaces is unchanged
business_review.notes: no CSS class changes; Announcement renders as aria-live region with no visible output; structural changes are fragment wrappers only

standards_review.notes: All 4 subjects match the documented EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence pattern: non-zero ticket ID EPMCDME-8469, first word 'Add' satisfies [A-Z][a-z]*, no trailing period
No code-quality.md found under .ai-run/guides/standards/; only git-workflow.md is present in that directory — absent standard, not a gap

finding_status.notes: AssistantsListPage.tsx line 67: hasActiveFilter = !checkEmptyFilters(filters); line 228: passed as hasActiveFilter={hasActiveFilter} to AssistantsList; AssistantList.tsx line 87: forwarded to AssistantGrid.
ContextSelector.tsx line 184: filterTerm.current = '' cleared immediately before fetchAssistantContextOptions() in handleDatasourcePopupClose, suppressing the spurious announcement.
AssistantFilters.tsx line 94: announces projectOptions.length (raw search result count) instead of resolvedProjectOptions.length.
AssistantGrid.tsx line 73: guard extended to if (!hasActiveFilter || totalCount === null) return, blocking null from reaching announce().

AssistantGrid.tsx line 81: searchVersion added to useEffect deps; AssistantsListPage.tsx line 229: searchVersion={loadVersion} passed down; loadVersion increments on every search trigger including same-term repeats.

AssistantGrid.tsx lines 66-76: prevHasActiveFilterRef tracks previous flag value; early return fires when !prevActive && hasActiveFilter (false→true transition), suppressing the stale pre-filter count.
AssistantGrid.tsx lines 79-80: zeroResultsMessage computed as 'No templates found' when isTemplate is true; passed into announce() correctly.
